rappel_detail.station: From the summit, downclimb a few hundred feet of easy terrain until you are below the North Face of Burgundy Spire; the rappel slings on horns are plain to see. Anchors are plentiful on this descent.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 2, about 30 m, to a ledge. Downclimb from the ledge to the next anchors.

rappel_detail.station: The next anchors, reached by downclimbing from the ledge.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 2 of 2, about 20 m, to the ground in the gully beneath Burgundy Col.

set.rappels: Scramble northeast from the top, then 2 rappels, about 30 m and 20 m, down to the gully beneath Burgundy Col
set.rappel_count_note: Two rappels, about 30 m and 20 m, with downclimbing before and between them. A 60 m rope works with a little extra downclimbing; a 70 m is more comfortable. Some parties make nine or ten shorter rappels on the same ground instead of downclimbing.
set.descent_text: From the top of pitch 4, parties can either scramble class-3 terrain northeast toward the base of Burgundy Spire’s North Face, downclimbing over precariously stacked blocks and flakes, to continue a link-up, or take Paisano’s standard descent: two rappels, about 30 m and 20 m, from slung horns down to the gully beneath Burgundy Col, then reverse the approach trail to the highway.
